prompt:
A desktop website homepage for Rubia Rocha Fotografia, a photographer in Curitiba, rendered edge to edge as the finished screen with crisp readable text. No browser chrome, no device, no desk. The visitor is deciding whether to hire her and must see the photographs and a way to request a quote.

Warm cream ground #f6f1eb. Top navigation: a thin handwritten script logo reading rubia rocha, then the links Home, Quem sou, Ensaios, Eventos, Blog, Contato in a plain sans. Home is the only link inside a blush pill #f3e4dc.

What leads the screen is three real photographs in a row. Left, a small child at a birthday party. Center, taller, a couple with foreheads touching. Right, a couple at a small outdoor wedding. Four tiny dots sit under the row; the first dot is dusty rose #b08978.

Under that, a circular portrait of a woman holding a camera, the serif headline “Oi! Eu sou a Rubia.”, one short paragraph in a workhorse sans about photographing families, pregnant women, babies, couples and events in Curitiba, and an outline pill button reading “Quero um orçamento”.

The section below has started: a white sheet, the small tracked label “Fotografia da vida real”, the serif headline “O que eu fotografo?”, and the beginning of four photographs labeled Mini casamentos, Festa infantil, Ensaio de casal and Ensaio de gestante.

Serif headlines, sans for links and buttons. Photographs sit directly on the cream, with no cards, no shadows, no black page, and no neon accent.
